summary: Recent updates to the 2D graphics library, Moz2D, have streamlined the codebase by removing the outdated MacIOSurface::CreateSinglePlanarSurface function, which was no longer necessary, thereby improving performance and maintainability. Additionally, adjustments were made to clamp various float parameters for software filters, ensuring that these filters operate more reliably and correctly handle the input values, which can enhance the overall quality of graphics rendering. While these changes primarily focus on internal optimizations, they contribute to the **overall stability and efficiency** of graphical applications within Firefox.
